name: Calibration Error Metric
description: Replaces the boolean OR clause and algebraic sum over {-1, 1} with a bounded sum of absolute calibration errors over {0, 1}. By defining target states and requiring the sum of absolute errors to be at most 1, it forces models to algebraically deduce that at most one parameter can be incorrect, breaking the immediate textual and algebraic pattern matching to a 2-SAT clause.
